entries.dialogueText: "Peace between Morella, Rizia and Derdia could be lucrative for all of us. Don't you realize that?"

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't you realize Morella is on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you realize Morella is on the verge of joining the CSP? Your insurgents will be blown to smithereens."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not about 'help'. It's about..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not about 'help'. It's about Derdians breaking the law."

entries.dialogueText: "As St. Wruhec has said, 'Laws devoid of justice are but chains upon the righteous. To break such chains is man's highest duty.'"

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You think a man of God can be boug..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think a man of God can be bought so easily?"

entries.dialogueText: "Are you aware of my country's weapons capabilities? We are more than prepared to fight for our right to holy pilgrimage."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""After your lip service to Derdia a..."
entries.dialogueText: "After your lip service to Derdia at the Alliance of Nations, you are siding with Morella after all. I shouldn't be surprised."
